title: feat(mix0line): run f_mix0 from the 3-site long-axis seed
science: Thin single-run confirmation: f_mix0, the F_cut member with remaining tuple (1,0,1,1,0) (i.e. L1 with mixed3 silenced), fills from the 3-site long-axis seed with T=2 and history (3,9,12), identical to f_L1's. Its only real contribution beyond the run is that it states the F_cut completion of that tuple explicitly - complements wt5=1, adj4=1, opp4=0, support 44 - which is exactly the disambiguation missing from #6407/#6411 where the same five-bit name is used for the support-26 map outside F_cut (see the #6414 collision note). Lowest-value member of the batch alongside #6405.
verdict_pair: reverse=none face=none (no (reverse,face) pair stated; pre-verdict campaign phase)
